title: Text: DET Matt Boyd ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: What’s going on, man? How is your off-season going
Hey man, couldn't be going better how are you doing ?
Good, ready for Florida. It’s freezing here. Saw your pitch shaping video on Instagram. Interested in hearing more about it. Just wanted to say what up, I’ll see you later this month.

Haha I bet man. Me too. It's pretty cool stuff. Stuff I've been doing last few offseason but taking on a different role this year. Driveline has high speed cameras that capture insane amounts of frames per second amd they have rapsodo machine that measures pitch metrics. Like 7 of them. So it is just another way to learn your pitches. Sometimes seeing how how u want your pitch to rotate or understanding what it actually does in reality gives you a much better idea of how to think, learn and become a better pitcher. Just trying to understand how my game functions even better! Not am end all be all but another tool
Sorry I'm driving up from Portland this afternoon lll
Yeah it seems like a great tool. What you doing in Portland?
It is man. Finally home. My wife's family is from there so we go there quite a bit
